content.short: Move is a learning resource for the Move programming language to create smart contracts on Aptos and Sui chains.
content.description: Move is a Rust-based programming language focused on safety for on-chain code. It was developed to support a blockchain project and is now used to write smart contracts on Aptos and Sui. Move's design prioritizes secure resource and asset handling, with syntax that helps developers minimize common errors and enforce strong safety guarantees. By adopting Move conventions, developers on Aptos and Sui can add security checks and more predictable contract behavior to their applications.
content.meta: Move is a Rust-based language originally developed for Meta's Diem project. Discover Move and other Web3 Developer Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Move 2024 Migration Guide
resources.tldr: Module labels, let mut, public structs, method syntax, enums and match. A language edition changing this much is rare, and it is direct about breakage.

resources.title: Code Quality Checklist
resources.tldr: A review checklist for Sui contracts covering safety, style and maintainability. Long enough to be genuinely useful rather than a list of platitudes.

resources.title: Upgradeability Practices
resources.tldr: Upgrading a package without breaking whatever depends on it is mostly a planning problem, not a technical one. Covers compatibility and versioning on Sui.
